descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologie, informații și mass-media
Cavendish Professionals are looking to speak to Cybersecurity Reporting and Data Analysts to join an exciting client with offices all over Europe. You will play a key role in producing detailed, accurate and actionable Cybersecurity metrics, reporting for senior management, business stakeholders and Cybersecurity practitioners.
 Skills and Requirements:
Minimum 6 years' experience working in IT / Information Security, preferably within the Financial Services industry, with atleast 5 of them in a Reporting role.
Experience using Cognos and Tableau, with experience building/maintaining reports and dashboards.
Strong understanding of ETL processes.
Experience crafting datasets to support interactive analytics.
Familiarity with SQL, databases and database design concepts.
Experience working with structured and unstructured data and analysing information from different perspectives.
Experience with simple macro writing and VBA programming.
 Candidate Profile:
Strong reporting and data analysis background, with experience producing precise and detailed Business Intelligence reports.
Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to perform quality control checks and identify discrepancies in source data and reports.
Customer-oriented, resourceful and enthusiastic.
Able to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
Comfortable multitasking, managing time effectively and meeting deadlines under pressure.
Focused on considering business enablement while reaching balanced information risk judgments.
Able to present data and reporting materials in a format that supports senior management decision-making.
 Role and Responsibilities:
Build and maintain highly detailed Business Intelligence reports in Cognos and Tableau.
Produce monthly, periodic and ad-hoc reports on designated Cybersecurity programmes and assigned topics.
Work with Cybersecurity programme owners to gather Cybersecurity risk data, process information and produce Information Security reports and metrics.
Maintain existing reports and ensure data accuracy, quality and consistency.
Produce datasets to support interactive analytics and maintain these through automated ETL jobs on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.
Create, maintain and improve interactive analytics dashboards with appropriate data visualisations.
Design and document business requirements supporting the automation of data feeds from upstream applications to the Cybersecurity reporting application.
Provide detailed, accurate and actionable Cybersecurity metrics and reporting to executive management, senior management, technology heads and Cybersecurity practitioners.
Support the definition and measurement of Cybersecurity risk, process, threat and operational indicators.
Deliver Cybersecurity metrics and interactive analytics in near real-time through the online Cybersecurity Business View application.
Provide details of Cybersecurity issues to Information Security practitioners.
Manage enhancements and changes to Cybersecurity reports and the Cybersecurity Business View in collaboration with programme owners.
Maintain historical Cybersecurity risk data.
 For more information – please apply for this job or send your CV directly and I will call you back to provide you with more details.
